reported.quote: So, the net sales in Q1 of FY26-'27 is INR3,185 crores against INR2,590 crores last year.
However, the total wire and cable sale in Q1 has grown by 24.4% against previous year.
During Q1 '26-'27, operating margin has improved to 12.43%
EBITDA in this quarter is INR415 crores against INR297 crores last year.
EBITDA/sales margin is 13.04% as against 11.49% in the same period previous year.
Profit after tax in this quarter is INR274 crores against INR195 crores.
PAT/net sales margin is 8.61% against 7.56% in the previous year same period.
